rules.text: Every library's hooks are installed in the memory phase, before the library allocates. In probe builds the facade tracks live blocks; releasing a block the facade never allocated fails the rule.
Each library's installed hooks are the facade's, and the facade observes allocations from that library during a smoke run.
Memory is freed by the allocator that allocated it; across DLL or hot-reload boundaries the hooks are installed per module.
